projects.name: Local Contractor Bid Organizer
projects.title: Local Contractor Bid Organizer
projects.customer_problem: Small contractors often track bids, customer notes and job status through scattered messages and paper.
projects.proposed_solution: A simple mobile dashboard for leads, estimates, bid status and customer follow-up.
objectives: Validate demand for Local Contractor Bid Organizer
Build a usable minimum viable product
Create a repeatable customer acquisition process
Test pricing with real prospective customers
Measure usage, conversion and customer feedback

risks.risk: Customer demand may be weaker than estimated
risks.mitigation: Validate with prospective customers before full build

risks.risk: MVP scope may grow too large
risks.mitigation: Limit the first release to essential workflows
Test setup-fee and subscription pricing options
Begin with local and approval-controlled workflows

assumptions: The target customer experiences the stated problem regularly
The customer is willing to use a mobile or web-based workflow
A focused MVP can be built without paid infrastructure
Early customer testing can be performed before public launch
The proposed revenue model is Monthly subscription
